item.title: Hawks beat slumping Bucks 131-113 to win 5th straight and climb above .500
item.description: MILWAUKEE (AP) — Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 23 points and the Atlanta Hawks defeated the slumping Milwaukee Bucks 131-113 on Wednesday night to win their fifth straight game and move above .500 for the first time since December. item.title: Canada’s Diallo advances at Indian Wells, Andreescu out in first round
item.description: INDIAN WELLS — Canada’s Gabriel Diallo picked up his first win in nearly two months on the ATP Tour, defeating Italy’s Mattia Bellucci in the first round of the Indian Wells tennis tournament.
